user.title: Connect your Telekom subscription
user.description: First run the browser login helper on your computer and complete Telekom login. Paste the contents of web-session.json below. Your password and SMS code are not needed here. Rotating session cookies are saved privately and renewed automatically while Telekom permits it.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Telekom again
reauth_confirm.description: Telekom expired or revoked the session. Run the browser login helper again and paste the new session export. Existing sensors will be kept.

error.invalid_input: Enter a valid Hungarian mobile number and a session JSON export containing the refresh cookie.
error.invalid_auth: This session cannot be renewed. Complete Telekom login again and export a new session.
error.account_mismatch: This session does not contain that subscription, or no account was selected during login.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot retrieve data from Telekom. Try again later.

abort.reauth_successful: The session was updated. Existing sensors will resume.

init.title: Update frequency
init.description: Poll every 15 minutes by default. Sessions renew automatically when needed.
